note: Prices for module types the old 2D designer never carried. Historically the only record of a unit price was an entry in DesignerEngine.moduleFilenames in js/designer-engine.js, which also needs two isometric SVGs per module for a page that is being retired. This file is the plain record that replaces it: a module type and what it sells for, VAT-inclusive, as everywhere else. scripts/build-canonical-prices.mjs reads both and fails if they disagree, so the two can coexist while the designer's entries are migrated across.
